Steps To Reproduce: Scanned WOs for a line carrying a staged/received part; found WO S9-24011 line a93ad8f1 in status 'authorized' with an inventory part in 'in_stock' (staged) status. | Attempted to decline it using the exact endpoint the Edit-Line status dropdown uses: POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-status {line_id, status:'authorization_declined'}. | Re-read the line to confirm the resulting status. | Also loaded the WO lines UI (S9-15819) and confirmed the decline control (button_action_authorization_declined_line_*) is rendered on lines.
What Should Happen: A line that has staged/received parts can be declined (parity with Production).
What Actually Happens Now: The decline succeeded: the endpoint returned HTTP 200 and the line with a staged part transitioned to 'authorization_declined' (and its parts reverted from in_stock back to quoted/requested). The line is no longer blocked from being declined. The UI exposes the decline action on lines.
Notes: Verified via the same change-status endpoint the UI's Edit Line > Status > Declined path invokes. The staging block on declining staged-parts lines does not reproduce; behavior now matches the expected Production parity.

What The Bug Is: When an invoice is paid using a customer's existing credit balance, the Payment entry shows the remaining credit instead of the invoice amount actually applied. Steps To Reproduce: As admin, opened customer 'new test' (account a3b829a5...) which had two unpaid invoices of $1,078.71 each. | Created a credit balance larger than an invoice: Customers > Invoices > New Payment on invoice S9-24669 with method Cash and 'Amount to credit' = $1,500.00 (Payment amount $2,578.71). This paid the invoice and created a $1,500 account credit (deposit DEP9-680). | Paid the remaining unpaid invoice S9-24661 ($1,078.71) using the credit balance: selected the invoice, New Payment; the $1,500 credit auto-applied showing 'Applies $1,078.71 - $421.29 remaining', Payment amount $0.00, and submitted (button 'Create Credit'). | Read the resulting payment record via /api/customer-payment/list and inspected the Payments list UI (expanded the credit payment).
What Should Happen: The Payment row should show the invoice amount paid (e.g. $10.00); the remaining credit ($4.18) should stay on the account as credit.
What Actually Happens Now: The credit-balance payment records the INVOICE AMOUNT APPLIED, not the remaining credit. API record for the new payment: applied_credits = -1078.71, credits[]=DEP-680 applied 1078.71; invoice S9-24661 is now marked 'Paid'. In the Payments UI the expanded payment shows 'Invoice S9-24661 $1,078.71 Paid' and 'Deposit DEP9-680 Excess Payment -$1,078.71 Applied'. The $421.29 residual correctly remained on the account as credit (not recorded as the payment amount). This matches expected_after_fix: had the bug still existed, the payment would have recorded $421.29 (remaining credit) instead of $1,078.71 (invoice amount).
Notes: Re-test of prior NEEDS-INFO. Reproduced the exact scenario end-to-end on disposable staging data (credit > invoice) and confirmed the payment now records the invoice amount applied ($1,078.71), with the surplus retained as credit ($421.29). Bug does not reproduce.
